summary: Fire and Frost hybrid built on Frostfire Bolt, which gets both trees' talents.
rotation: The on-use trinket once Fire Vulnerability has 5 stacks; other cooldowns on a free GCD; mana gems never (they share the rune's cooldown)
Evocation below 20% mana with more than 45s left
Ice Lance on every Fingers of Frost charge, ahead of Scorch and Pyroblast (3 times the damage, Shatter crit)
Scorch to 5 Fire Vulnerability stacks and again with under 7s left
Pyroblast at 3 Heating Up stacks (1.5s cast)
Arcane Missiles on a Missile Barrage proc
Fire Blast on cooldown above 80% mana, and with mana the fight can't use (above 70 per second of fight left); every Fire Blast adds a Heating Up stack
Rank 2 Frostfire Bolt once Evocation is spent or under 60s left, while mana is under 60 per second of fight left
Ice Lance instead when a Frostfire Bolt would not land before the end (its cast plus 1.5s)
consumes: Scroll of Imbue Greater Flame (staff imbue, on top of the oil)
caveats: Ice Lance's spell power coefficient is 0.429 (SoD server value, the client has 0).
Heating Up: every Fire Blast adds a stack (two on a crit). One Pyroblast uses them all.
Fire Power counts Fire Vulnerability and up to 4 Fire DoTs. Open: whether it adds or multiplies. Frostfire Bolt gets it, but its DoT doesn't count.
Frost Channeling 3 does nothing but leads to Fingers of Frost.
Frostfire Bolt's DoT has no client coefficient.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Fireball XI, Frostbolt X, Arcane Missiles VII). With the books: Frost +50, Arcane +30, Fire +17, Frostfire 0.
notes: Request written by mksettings -spec mage_frostfire unchanged (shared level 60 raid with Mana Spring Totem and Blessing of Wisdom in place of Might; Mage Armor; Engineering/Tailoring). It carries the spec's staff imbue scroll (Scroll of Imbue Greater Flame) as a mage option, as the preset does. Its rotation casts Ice Lance on every Fingers of Frost charge and Evocation below 30% mana with more than 60s left.
